name: Kaguyahime
source: [url=/c91602]Jack's[/url] mysterious underclassman who usually hangs around in the school infirmary. A lazy girl who has been rumored to never show up for classes, and initially sees Jack only as a convenient errand boy, especially because he has a hard time saying "no." She always moves around with the mysterious chair which she calls "Bamboo No. 1".
